title: Step 0 brief (a person writes it; the run reads it before the bets step)

goal.description: What the page test should achieve (flow v2 step 1).

page_url.description: The live page address (flow v2 step 1).

scope.description: 'page' or 'section:<name>' (flow v2 step 2). A section name comes from the latest capture.

checklist.description: One buyer checklist id. null while a typed persona waits for step 3c to draft one (the run brief always has an id).

decides.description: What this buyer decides. Required by step 3 for a new brief. Older briefs may lack it.

must_see.description: What this buyer must see before acting. Required by step 3 for a new brief.

source.description: shortcut: a role from the page profile. typed: the person typed the buyer.

vertical.description: The one vertical this test is for, in the person's own words (flow v2 step 3). The code holds no list of verticals.

offer_after_click.description: What the buyer gets after the click, or 'UNKNOWN: <reason>'.

open_conflicts.description: Must be empty before a run starts.

main_cta.description: The one button label. Both arms use it (lesson L18).

test_type.description: message: only words change. design: only layout or motion changes (flow v2 step 5). One test changes one thing.

product.description: The product this page sells (step 1). Older briefs may lack it.
